My goal is to maximize profit, which is my value minus my bid. My value is $31. To win, I should bid slightly above the average expected bid of others. Assuming others bid close to their values, around $25, I will bid $26. This gives me a potential profit of $5 if I win. Bidding too high risks negative profit, and bidding too low risks losing the auction. Given no history, this strategy balances risk and reward.
